articles.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday. VIX and bitcoin say the fear may fade Monday.
articles.snippet: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin suggest the same.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
articles.snippet: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.

articles.title: Circle defends USDC economics as stablecoin rivals court its partners with bigger cut
articles.snippet: Coinbase, Circle’s largest USDC partner, also backs Open USD, a rival network that passes reserve income to partners after a management fee.

articles.title: Goldman, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley see tokenization as a growth play, not a threat
articles.snippet: The largest banks in the world are eyeing new trading opportunities, speeding up payments and a role for advisers as tokenization takes root in Wall Street.

articles.title: Scammer gets scammed in Ledger spy-chip exploit, loses almost $5 million in bitcoin
articles.snippet: Chainalysis says a fraudster who tricked people through fake online jobs became one of the biggest victims of the compromised hardware wallets.
